items.title: Bloomingdale’s Casual Roots and Refined Tailoring Collide to Build the Blueprint for Modern Men’s Dressing
items.summary: Streetwear fundamentally altered luxury and contemporary fashion, but its influence is now splintering into exciting new territories. Today’s style culture is defined by fluid self-expression: music subcultures, West Coast nostalgia, European tailoring, and high-level material craftsmanship all converge into one singular narrative. Men are no longer dressing for rigid occasions or hiding behind uniform silhouettes; instead, they are mixing dramatic proportions with tactile luxury and relaxed elegance.
